newsitem.title: USA: Petco to acquire Pet Food Warehouse.
newsitem.headline: Petco to acquire Pet Food Warehouse.

text.p: Petco Animal Supplies Inc said on Friday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Pet Food Warehouse Inc.
Under the pact, 0.2 share of Petco will be exchanged for each share of Pet Food.
Petco said it plans to issue about 1.9 million shares in the transaction. It said it currently has 16.3 million shares outstanding and Pet Food has 9.4 million shares outstanding.
The deal is expected to be accretive in 1997 and thereafter, Petco said.
Petco said the transaction, intended to qualify as a tax-free pooling of interests, is expected to close in December and has been approved by the boards of both companies.
The deal is subject to approval by Pet Food shareholders and regulatory authorities, the company said.
Minneapolis, Minn.- based Pet Food operates 28 pet food and supply stores in the Upper Midwest. It has annual sales exceeding $70 million, Petco said.
With the addition of the Pet Food stores, Petco said it will operate 305 stores, including 240 superstores.
